profile_text.body:
Hugging Face is a for-profit AI company founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as being on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science, and it positions itself as a community platform for AI researchers and developers.

The company's primary products are the Hugging Face Hub, a hosting and discovery platform for machine learning models, datasets, and applications, and Hugging Face Transformers, an open-source library for working with pretrained models and running inference. Both products are considered significant to AI supply-chain tracking and AI bill of materials considerations, with the Hub also supporting model card verification and security scanning.

The held facts note a registered MCP server, co.huggingface/hf-mcp-server, described as enabling connections to the Hugging Face Hub and thousands of Gradio AI applications. The company has a notable legal exposure profile associated with New York, with 220 recorded entries under that jurisdiction, though no specific cases are listed in the available data.
